items.period: Seal-script tradition; specimen date not established
items.tradition: Shuowen small-seal style, modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern redraw in small-seal style shows three upright strokes joined by a curved base, with the middle stroke extending farther down. The character is identified as a pictograph of mountain peaks, though the listed script forms do not establish a continuous sequence of graphic changes.
items.alt: Three tall upright strokes rise from a curved base; the middle stroke extends below the two side strokes.
items.selection_reason: Shows the identified small-seal-style form and its visible shape. The pictographic interpretation is supported independently, but this redraw does not establish how the character’s form changed over time.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, stated on the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw, not an ancient inscription image. Its seal-script style is identified, but it does not establish a specimen date or a continuous sequence of graphic changes.
